coords = cbind(gunma$lon, gunma$lat)
nb = poly2nb(gunma, queen = TRUE)
w = nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

gunma = gunma %>%
  mutate(x = sp,
         adj_sp = lag.listw(w, x))

mt = moran.test(gunma$x, w)
set.seed(5460)
mc = moran.mc(gunma$x, w, nsim = 199)
band = quantile(mc$res[1:199], probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

gunma %>%
  filter(muni_code == "10201") %>%
  select(muni, x, adj_sp)
